prompts.prompt: Curved outward housing corridor inside a rotating asteroid-built habitat: apartment doors on the outer wall, pipes and cable trays on the inner wall, ribbed shell supports, dark consolidated aggregate, grated floor, yellow pressure door, cyan shift scanner, and a dented care table with lidded jars and colored clips.

Administrative confrontation around one dented table: sealed clinic parcel, broth jars, colored task clips, apartment threshold, cyan scanner field, pressure-door swing arc, human household, red-brown cephalopod harness, slate-gray biodrone, and tired shift clerk all share the frame.

Next-shift neighbors gather around the public care table beside the scanner: human rigger, child placing a fresh blue clip, cephalopod in wheeled harness, and six-limbed biodrone beneath a wall display with several separate warnings; fresh jars prove the handoff continues.

Care table just inside an open apartment doorway: child sets clips beside the clinic parcel, human rigger holds the door, cephalopod tentacle reads the table edge, and six-limbed biodrone scratches a route map underneath while the industrial corridor remains visible outside.
